Me, I am an old man now, farming this small piece of land near my home like I have done for many years. In Shinyanga here the rains are not always good, and I have no money for these fertilizers from the shop — I just put the manure from my goats and chickens when I can. I plant my usual seeds that I keep from last season, mixed together on the same plot so if one crop fails another will feed us. My sons and wife help me with the hoeing and weeding, and sometimes I call a neighbor for a few days when the weeds are too much during the rains.
